ns2:course.label: Grp Instr Pno for Mus Major I
ns2:course.description: (MUSIC 160) Beginning group instruction in piano for music majors whose principal performing medium is voice, or an orchestral or band instrument; study of simple piano literature, development of skills in technique, sight reading, harmonization, transposition, improvisation, and analysis. Class Schedual Information: For school of music majors only.
